# Braiding Sweetgrass

Started in October for book club. Essays from a botanist who is also a member of the Potawatomi Nation.

## So far

The chapter on the Three Sisters, corn, beans and squash grown together, is the one I keep thinking about. The corn gives the beans something to climb, the beans feed the soil, and the squash leaves shade out weeds. I want to try it on the allotment next year, see [[Garden Log]].

It sits well next to [[The Overstory]]: both are about paying attention to plants as more than scenery.
